MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 17
   C. 12
   D. 6

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 17

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 9

   A. 27
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 31

5. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5

   A. 18 cm³

   D. 36

17. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)

   D. 2.5

18. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81

   D. 9

19. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

20. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
